backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend, defining data types and state for comment lists, app events, chat messages, images, settings, and pricing, with CRUD operations and access-control enforcement via mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference for the frontend codebase structure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering colors for backgrounds, cards, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component providing the app shell with background music control, a countdown timer, floating decorative shapes, four-tab navigation (User View, Upload, Live Checker, Admin), and a sticky header.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin unlock form component that accepts a 4-digit code and calls the useAdminAuth hook to authenticate, displaying errors inline.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: Bulk comment generator component that validates an access key, selects a comment list, generates multiple comments client-side via useCommentGenerator, and provides a copy-all output with quantity capped to available templates.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: SVG donut chart component that visualizes the ratio of used to total templates with a gradient arc and a centered percentage label.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A React canvas-based top-down shooter game component where the player moves with WASD/arrow keys, shoots by clicking, and survives against spawning enemies, tracking score and time.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that lets users type and submit a comment via the `useAddChatMessage` mutation, displaying loading, success, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: A hook that manages admin authentication via a hardcoded PIN code, persisting the unlocked state in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: A hook that manages an HTML Audio element for background music, supporting play/pause toggling based on a URL and enabled flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useClaimedComments.ts: A hook that stores and retrieves per-device claimed comment records in localStorage, keyed by device ID and list ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: A hook that generates random comments from a CommentList's templates, supporting single and bulk generation with optional suffix and append symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: A hook that returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to the next midnight, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: A hook that retrieves or generates a persistent random UUID device identifier stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: A React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login, logout, and identity state via the DFINITY AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: A collection of React Query hooks for all backend data operations including comment lists, user profiles, app imports, events, and price entries, wrapping the ICP actor with caching and mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for a dark neon theme, and provides utility classes like glass-card, gradient-heading, and neon-text.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/utils/liveListParser.ts: Parses a WhatsApp-style live list report text (with asterisk-wrapped app names and numbered usernames) into structured ParsedAppEntry objects grouped by app name and optional date.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Generates randomized review/comment templates by combining tone-specific adjectives and phrase banks across categories (performance, UI, features, support) with variable length suffixes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to remove sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: Admin view for generating templated comments by topic and tone using a local template engine, with options to select generated templates and add them to an existing comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: Admin chat panel that displays and sends messages stored on-chain, auto-refreshing every 5 seconds with a scrollable message list and input field.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: Admin view for managing comment lists, supporting create, rename, delete, lock/unlock, adding templates, and viewing available comments and metrics per list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminEarnings.t: Admin earnings dashboard that displays a summary and per-app breakdown of total entries and calculated earnings based on app pricing data.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin image management view that allows uploading images with a name and tags, showing an upload progress bar and a gallery of existing images.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin panel tab for managing live lists: supports creating/renaming/deleting app event lists, adding usernames via text or file upload, and auto-importing from a pasted report with preview and import summary.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminPricing.ts: Admin panel tab for managing per-app price entries: supports adding, editing, deleting individual entries, and bulk uploading prices via CSV-style text input.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin panel tab for managing the access key (view, generate, save) and background music settings (toggle enable/disable, upload music file with progress tracking).
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel view that gates access behind admin authentication and renders tabbed navigation across all admin sub-sections (Comments, AI Templates, Images, Chat, Live List, Pricing, Earnings, Settings).
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: A view component providing a multi-app username checker that searches usernames across app/event lists, displays match positions, and calculates total earnings based on active price entries.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: A view component for uploading comment templates from text files to selected lists, uploading rating images as binary blobs, and rendering the UploadComment and BulkCommentGenerator sub-components.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: Main user-facing view that lets users select a comment list, claim/generate a unique comment, and copy it to clipboard, with localStorage persistence to prevent duplicate claims per device.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, oklch-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations including neon pulse and fade-in effects.
project_state.json: Project state document summarizing the app's architecture, existing features, known issues, and version history for an app review/rating platform with admin panel and Motoko canister backend.
